name: Bvlgari Hotel Paris
insider_take: Where Italian artistry meets Parisian elegance in the heart of the Golden Triangle, creating an ultra-luxe sanctuary that redefines opulence.
whats_special: This stunning property occupies a magnificent 1920s Art Deco building on Avenue George V, featuring only 76 rooms and suites designed with Bvlgari's signature Italian craftsmanship. The hotel boasts the largest spa in Paris at 1,300 square meters, complete with a 25-meter swimming pool finished in striking black granite and gold mosaics. The rooftop Il Ristorante offers breathtaking views of the Eiffel Tower and Sacré-Cœur.
pro_tip: Book the Bvlgari Suite for exclusive access to a private terrace with panoramic city views and personalized Bvlgari jewelry styling sessions.
dont_miss: The hotel's prime location puts you steps from luxury shopping on Champs-Élysées and Avenue Montaigne. Experience the signature Bvlgari Spa treatments using precious gemstone-infused products, and don't miss the evening aperitivo at Il Bar with its curated selection of rare Italian spirits and cigars in the climate-controlled humidor.
pros: Iconic luxury Italian design and jewelry-inspired interiors
Prime location on prestigious Avenue George V near Champs-Élysées
World-class spa featuring signature Bvlgari treatments
Michelin-starred dining and rooftop terrace with Eiffel Tower views
cons: Intimate boutique size may have limited availability
